ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Off`. The next timeout is 500 ms away: `sleepT` = 500.

With `@SimulateSleep` the chart assumes that exactly the requested time passed: `deltaT` is set to the last `sleepT` (500), so the timeout fires at once and the LED comes on. On wants 300 ms: `sleepT` = 300.
`deltaT` = 500: on. Every tick is a timeout; nothing happens in between.
